title: linked.app.json
description: A linked app's declarative settings, at the app root. Packages never have one.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the file follows. A tool refuses a version it does not know.

prefixes.description: The app's prefix map: prefix → namespace IRI. Its server, its browser bundle and its store queries all use it. Tools only add entries (`linked prefixes`); a rename or removal is the app owner's.

cssMode.description: CSS processing the server applies for server-side rendering in development: Tailwind CSS v4, or PostCSS (the default).

syncShapesOnBoot.description: Materialize the app's registered shapes into its data store as SHACL on boot. false for a server whose default dataset routes data per context, or an app that manages its own shape and dataset lifecycle.

datasetCloneScript.description: The npm script that copies the app's data into a dataset named by its one argument (npm run <script> -- <dataset>); linked worktree add --dataset prints it.

publish.description: What linked build-app ships besides the Vite bundle, and where releases go.

staticAssets.description: Globs of files under public/ to ship besides the bundle.

releasePrefix.description: The base key every release is nested under.

rpcExposure.description: enforce: only provider methods declared callable are reachable over /call, every other one answers 501. warn (the default) runs them with a warning. LINKED_RPC_EXPOSURE, when set, wins over this.

rawQueries.description: Raw SPARQL on /api/select-raw: off for everyone, or session (the default): a signed-in session.

apiOnly.description: Serve only the backend API: no server-side page rendering, page requests get a 404. linked start --api-only sets this.

cachePaths.description: Paths whose server-side rendered pages are cached in memory.

cacheTimeout.description: Milliseconds a cached page is served before it is rendered again.
